moat_against: Datadog broader and larger; Cisco-Splunk larger still — Dynatrace is #3 in its market
Hyperscaler bundled monitors, Grafana/OpenTelemetry open source, and cheaper New Relic pressure pricing
Revenue growth decelerating (guided ~+14.6% FY27) and SBC ~15% of revenue keeps OE thin
moat_for: Davis causal AI — deterministic root-cause on a unified platform; Gartner Leader 16 straight years
OneAgent deployed across the enterprise estate — real switching friction; consolidation wins, Q1 new-logo ARR +160%
Consumption (DPS) pricing expands with data volume; logs/AI observability are fast-growing expansion vectors
moat_justification: Davis causal AI on a unified platform with enterprise deployment switching costs and 16 straight years as a Gartner Leader, but #3 in a three-body market behind Datadog and Cisco-Splunk, with hyperscaler bundles, open-source/OpenTelemetry and cheaper rivals pressuring pricing, decelerating revenue growth, and SBC just under 15% of revenue keeping owner's earnings thin.
name: Dynatrace, Inc.
one_liner: Quality observability franchise, moat 6/10, but SBC consumes over half of OCF and the $64.01 price is ~4x the $15.25 weighted IV@15% — fails the 15% hurdle in every scenario; it would need to fall to ~$15 to clear it.
